summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is listed among organizations that responded to the draft EIS without substantive comments. A sub-component, the Federal Highway Administration, is noted, and the Assistant Secretary for Environment, Safety and Consumer Affairs provided only editorial/presentational comments on the report text. No policy position or substantive objection to the proposed fuel economy standards was expressed.
complaint_summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation is listed as one of the organizations that responded to the draft EIS without substantive comments, with the Federal Highway Administration noted as a sub-component and the Assistant Secretary for Environment, Safety and Consumer Affairs providing only presentational text improvements.
